candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Change 'MinSum = _val;' to 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value differs from the input.
Remove the initialized guard so SetMinSum can be called after initialization.
Remove the assignment so MinSum is never updated.
Assign _val + 1 instead of _val so MinSum stores an off-by-one value.
Delete the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the LogFile address is never set, making SetLogFile() return address(0).
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetLogFile overwrites the Log address even after initialization, allowing the stored address to change.
Delete the statement 'acc.balance += msg.value;' so deposits are never recorded in the holder's balance.
Replace 'acc.balance += msg.value;' with 'acc.balance = msg.value;' so each deposit overwrites instead of accumulating the balance.
Delete the statement updating acc.unlockTime so the unlock time is never set or extended.
Replace the conditional unlockTime update with an unconditional assignment 'acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp + _lockTime;' so lock times can also be shortened.
Replace 'acc.balance += msg.value;' with 'acc.balance += 1;' so the recorded balance no longer reflects the deposited value.
Delete the statement 'acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);' so the recorded balance is never decremented on withdrawal.
Delete the 'block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' condition from the withdrawal guard so funds can be collected before the lock expires.
Change the balance/MinSum guard 'acc.balance>=MinSum' to 'acc.balance>MinSum' so withdrawals are blocked when balance equals MinSum.
Delete the 'Log.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"Collect");' statement so successful collections are no longer recorded in the log history.
Change the timestamp guard 'block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime' to 'block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime' so withdrawals are allowed exactly at the unlock time.
Remove the guard so SetMinSum updates MinSum even after initialization.
Remove the assignment so SetMinSum never changes MinSum.
Move the assignment before the initialization guard so MinSum is set before the revert check.
